result.title: MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations
result.summary: Weight-activation quantization can reduce the memory and compute cost of neural-network inference, but recent methods often require expensive optimization and architecture-specific propagation of basis transforms across layers. We introduce MACaQ, an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that treats every linear layer independently. MACaQ applies a per-channel scale and a block-Hadamard transform online to each layer's activations, while absorbing the corresponding inverse transforms into its weights. Retaining these transforms online avoids cross-layer dependencies and enables a simple streaming implementation of the quantization process, in which only one layer must reside in memory at a time. To improve over round-to-nearest quantization, we introduce Flip-Refinement, a Hessian-aware coordinate-descent procedure that greedily moves individual FP4 codes to adjacent representable values. Despite executing the activation transforms at inference time, MACaQ adds only 2.3% end-to-end overhead over pure MXFP4 on Qwen3-32B in vLLM. MACaQ reaches lower perplexity than DuQuant++ and MR-GPTQ, and already matches their best perplexity on Llama-3-8B in 11 times less quantization time. We further apply MACaQ without architecture-specific modifications to an image diffusion model, illustrating the generality of its layer-local design and show quantization of a 122B parameter model in 64 minutes, using only 32.5GB GPU RAM.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MACaQ，一种 MXFP4 W4A4 的训练后量化方法：对每个线性层独立施加在线 per-channel 缩放与 block-Hadamard 变换并将逆变换吸收进权重，再用 Hessian 感知的「Flip-Refinement」逐码坐标下降改善舍入，实现流式、模型无关的量化。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作本身面向推理压缩，与 LVR 的状态生成、证据筛选无直接关系；但其对激活施加可逆在线变换并对离散码做局部校正的思路，可能可供核查低精度激活对 latent 状态保真度的影响，以及离散 latent 表示的细粒度修正线索。
